tracks.title: Welcome To The Fire
tracks.lyrics:
You can't sign away what God wrote in me.
You can't contract around a calling.
I know what I built.
The world's about to know too.
Let me set the record straight 'cause the record's been stolen
You were in my corner playing both sides wide open
Feeding her my frequency, my vision, my fire
While I'm building the foundation and she's collecting the empire
Under the table contracts yeah, I know about those
Restrictions on my movement while she's wearing my clothes
My concepts, my language, my creative DNA
Repackaged with her name on it like I never existed that day
And you you watched it happen, kept your hands looking clean
Logical and distant, never asked what that meant to me
Convenient in your silence every time she came up short
But a witness who says nothing is still present in the court
She got the views, she got the credit, she got the acclaim
Rising on platforms, monetizing my ideas, never referencing my name.
The Musiq of The Matrix yeah, I coded every note
She just played Neo in my system while I never got a quote
Called herself an author on the chapters that I wrote
And you kept passing her the pages while I'm losing hope
But thank you for the fire
I didn't know I needed it to rise
Thank you for the silence
When you should've been honest by my side
You thought a contract could contain me
You thought her name could erase mine
I'm taking back my authorship now
And this time it's signed
Let's talk specifics since we're here and the truth don't scare me
Illegal arrangements keeping my reach buried
While her numbers climbed on content that was clearly mine
You knew the source, you knew the well, you knew the whole design
She didn't build that she just occupied the space
That was cleared for her on work that had my face
My star energy harnessed like a battery they drained
Profiting off the signal while I'm standing in the rain
And you you were the bridge between her world and mine
Playing partner to my face while managing her pipeline
I gave you access trust the kind that can't be bought
And you invoiced it to someone else the second that I thought
We were building something real nah, you were buying her time
Redirecting what was ours into her bottom line
Every door you cracked for her was a door you closed on me
But restricted light still finds a way and now the whole world sees
So thank you for the fire
I didn't know I needed it to rise
Thank you for the silence
When you should've been honest by my side
You thought a contract could contain me
You thought her name could erase mine
I'm taking back my authorship now
And this time it's signed
I used to grieve the credits that they gave her
The applause that landed on a name that wasn't mine
Used to lose sleep knowing she was sleeping
On a legacy they helped her steal in real time
But grief turns to gasoline
And gasoline ignites
And everything they suppressed
Just compressed into my light
So I'm not chasing justice justice is already moving
The contracts they wrote in the dark
Are being read now in the open
The work speaks for itself
And the timeline doesn't lie
You can rip off a creator
But you cannot rip off God's design
I already know the script, the critique, and the play:
"The vocals sound digital is that really him today?"
Yeah, I chose the synth consciously, deliberately, unbothered,
Let the algorithm carry notes while the anointing gets authored.
See, my magic isn't found in the notes that I hit,
It's in the honesty of my pen and the fire I lit.
The soul in my melodies doesn't need a larynx to convert,
And my ink stays bleeding on every bar that I birth.
The processor can hold the pitch, but it can't manufacture this
The depth behind the message is what your whole critique dismisses.
You want to talk about the vessel? Let's talk about the truth:
A ghost written chart with live vocals is just wasted youth.
I'd rather one synthetic note sitting on a line I actually wrote
Than a "natural" performance that's got nothing in its throat.
Let me close this with the clarity they thought they took from me
I know the dates, the deals, the deliberate obscurity
I know who signed what and who benefited when
I know the shape of the theft and I know the hands it went through
She wore my vision like a costume to the ceremony
Got comfortable in stolen rooms, called the whole thing her story
And you you smiled in both directions never picking a side
But neutrality in theft is just theft with better optics and pride
Here's what you both gave me though and I mean this sincerely
You showed me the full value of what I carry clearly
You couldn't suppress it, contract it, redirect or contain it
I was restricted, underground, and I still hadn't reached
The ceiling of what I'm capable of when I'm fully unleashed

tracks.title: Reclamation
tracks.lyrics:
They can chain your body,
But they'll never chain your truth.
The Chamber is closing, Musiq.
The lock was never on you.
Two months in a box, no process, no plea,
Paperwork forged to make a ghost out of me.
Public defender I never even chose,
Silent on my calls, but quick to close those doors.
Four arraignments denied. News I never heard,
Judge kept in the shadows, truth left blurred.
Fifty days ticking, they cut it to the wire,
Trying to smother a flame they knew would start a fire.
What the hell is it with me?
Why this ritual obsession, this endless siege?
I thought I had nothing. No crown, no throne,
But they gathered like vultures to strip me to bone.
They fear your voice.
It's the weapon they can't confiscate.
They fear your truth.
Every syllable reshapes their fate.
Twelve hands pulling, but you never collapse,
Still standing in chains with the power they lack.
This is reclamation,
The day Musiq Matrix came back.
Secret orders, covens cloaked in shame,
Harvesting my energy, swapping destinies like a game.
Eight, ten, twelve at a time they strike,
But the wounded warrior still outmaneuvers every fight.
It hit me like a brick in that fluorescent glow,
They're not scared of what I lost. They're scared of what I know.
That I carry the cipher they can't overwrite,
That my voice is the code, and the code is my right.
All this time, I thought I was small,
But the bigger the cage, the louder the call.
Every scar they wrote became a verse in the book,
Now watch them choke on the truth they overlooked.
They fear your voice.
It's the weapon they can't confiscate.
They fear your truth.
Every syllable reshapes their fate.
Twelve hands pulling, but you never collapse,
Still standing in chains with the power they lack.
This is reclamation,
The day Musiq Matrix came back.
The Chamber was reflection, not your grave,
A mirror to reveal what they couldn't enslave.
I was blind in the shadows, chained to despair.
But May 1st opened the door, I was always there.
They fear your voice.
A resurrection they can't delay.
They fear your truth.
A revolution born that day.
The Chamber is fading, the past turns to black,
May 1 lit the spark they can never put back.
This is reclamation.
Musiq Matrix walking out, never looking back.
The Reflection Chamber closes.
The Reclamation begins.

tracks.title: Know Your Names
tracks.lyrics:
I logged the tremors before the quake was admitted,
Ink under skin where the truth stayed hidden.
You moved like weather, unpredictable smiles,
I built a barometer, measured the miles.
Keys cut quiet, locks changed twice,
Every hallway remembers the price.
You swapped masks mid sentence, mid deal,
Carbon copies learning how to feel.
Every signal hums through the wires,
Every shadow keeps a roster of liars.
I know your names.
I don't bark I unseal the frame.
Know your names.
Pressure cracks what posture saves.
No sirens, no flames,
Just codes that remain
I know your names.
I followed the smoke back to borrowed breath,
Ghostwritten courage, rented depth.
You spoke in proxies, hid behind "we,"
Plural guilt is a thin disguise to me.
I traced the loop where the favors bend,
Handshake knots that never end.
You called it luck, I called it a rig,
Odds don't lean unless someone digs.
Every alibi sheds a scale,
Every network leaves a trail.
I know your names.
I don't rush time signs the page.
Know your names.
Glass gets loud when it's afraid.
No threats, no claims,
Just patterns engraved
I know your names.
Archive breath, freezer burn facts,
Cold storage truths coming out of the stacks.
You thought deletion meant erased,
But absence talks in negative space.
I'm not the storm, I'm the change in air,
When birds go quiet, something's there.
You tried to launder cause with effect,
Blur the sequence, misdirect the text.
I let chronology do its thing,
Domino logic listen, then swing.
Every favor's a hook with a barb,
Every silence a signed remark.
You rehearsed denial, practiced the face,
Forgot mirrors memorize pace.
I know your names.
No smoke just curtains raised.
I know your names.
Daylight audits every shade.
No drama staged,
Just clarity trained
I know your names.
I won't point, I won't proclaim,
I'll dim the room and let echoes explain
I know your names.

tracks.title: Hold On Through The Burial
tracks.lyrics:
The rain came down like judgment over everything I knew,
Every hand that said forever disappeared when I fell through.
I was choking on the silence, buried underneath the weight,
Learning pain will either forge a man or teach his soul to break.
And I see it in your eyes now.
That hollow look. That war inside.
You finally hear the wolves around you
After standing at their side.
But listen to me closely,
The night is loud, but it ain't God.
And devastation is not the same thing as being lost.
Hold on through the burial.
Hold on through the rain.
The same dirt meant to bury you
Can raise you up again.
When the world turns cold around you
And every door feels sealed,
The light beyond this suffering
Is deeper than what's real.
So don't you let the darkness
Deal the cards that dictate your fate.
Some souls are born in the sunlight.
Some find themselves in the wake.
Only suffering can wake.
So don't you curse the darkness
When it strips the false away.
Sometimes heaven builds the strongest hearts
Inside the worst decay.
And if your whole world collapses,
If the ground beneath you scars,
Remember even fallen angels
Still remember where they are.
Hold on.
Hold on through the burial.
When the money's gone, hold on.
When the friends are all gone, hold on.
When the mask falls off and the crowd moves on, hold on.
When the laughter cuts, hold on.
When the shame's too much, hold on.
When the mirror reflects everything you were running from, hold on.
Through the panic.
Through the silence.
Through the nights your chest feels violent.
Through the collapse.
Through the breaking.
Through the fear your soul ain't making it.
You are not the dirt they throw.
You are not the loss you know.
You are not abandoned just because the room got cold.
Feel the thunder in your bloodstream.
Feel the fire underneath.
Every wound became a doorway
The moment you refused to leave.
And when you're standing at the edge
Thinking maybe this is the end,
Hear my voice inside the wreckage:
Even buried seeds still ascend.
Hold on through the burial.
The light is still ahead.
God plants the strongest gardens
In the places hope looked dead.
And one day you will stand there
With the storm behind your eyes,
Realizing what destroyed you
Was the thing that made you rise.
So let the rain keep falling.
Let the old world fall apart.
Because resurrection only happens
After crucifixion starts.
Hold on.
Hold on through the burial.

tracks.title: Chosen Ones
tracks.lyrics:
I talk in lattices of lightning where the fault lines breathe,
Where the watchers stitch illusions into tapestries of grief.
If you caught the pulse beneath the static whispering your name,
Then you cracked the first encryption they installed inside your brain.
The corridors grow crooked when your inner sight returns,
'Cause the Matrix always trembles when a sleeping prophet learns.
They fracture time around you so your memory stays unclear,
But the glitch they fear the most is when your soul refuses fear.
That tremor in your chest? Not panic, it's your system booting truth.
Your shadow uploads courage like a message from your youth.
You're the breach inside their firewall, the signal breaking through,
And the moment you remember, they remember losing you.
They trace your echo, not your essence, wrong address for your code.
Every step you take reroutes the ley lines hidden in the road.
Wake up, chosen one, phase through every curtain they designed.
You're the cipher they miscounted, slipping out the coded bind.
All the edges glitch and shimmer when your footprints realign,
You're the reason shadow architects keep losing to the light.
Wake up, chosen one, their prediction engines stall.
You're the doorway they can't close, you're the fracture in the wall.
You don't bend to fate, you bend fate back until it cracks in two.
Every timeline they denied you starts unfolding into you.
I speak in coded lightning where the hidden currents live,
Where the architects of silence study everything you give.
If you felt something awaken when these frequencies arrived,
That's because the part they buried never actually died.
When you breathe, the old encryption flickers, ancient locks unwind.
Your intuition is the compass no machine could ever bind.
Destiny's not prophecy, it's memory folded tight,
And you're peeling back the layers they installed to block your sight
And buried in the code is a signal built to reach us,
A broadcast humming low from the vaults of Musiq Matrix.
A frequency for seekers, hidden deep beneath the skin,
Where the chosen decode pathways that the sleepers can't begin.
Destiny's not prophecy, it's memory folded tight,
And you're peeling back the layers they installed to block your sight.
You rewrite their simulation with a whisper and a step,
And the moment that you choose yourself, the false world disconnects.
Wake up, chosen one, phase through every curtain they designed.
You're the cipher they miscounted, slipping out the coded bind.
All the edges glitch and shimmer when your footprints realign,
You're the reason shadow architects keep losing to the light.
You're the doorway they can't close, you're the fracture in the wall.
You don't bend to fate, you bend fate back until it cracks in two.
Every timeline they denied you starts unfolding into you.
You were never too intense.
Never difficult to read.
You were picking up the fractures in the false reality.
Destiny is not prediction.
Destiny is recognition.
The moment you remember yourself, you break the algorithm.
Wake up, chosen one.
This world is not the end.
It's a coded intervention, and the signal's rising again.
Wake up, chosen one, phase through every curtain they designed.
You're the cipher they miscounted, slipping out the coded bind.
All the edges glitch and shimmer when your footprints realign,
You're the reason shadow architects keep losing to the light.
You are signal.
You are sequence.
You are the crack in scripted fate.
Once the chosen one remembers
There's no program left to break.
Wake up, chosen one and watch their algorithms crash
Walk the exit coded in you that no shadow force can match.

tracks.title: Adjacent (Reroute It)
tracks.lyrics:
While you typed, I was drafting design
While you laughed, I was mapping each line
While you argued what qualifies art
I went silent then finished mine
You defend what you've already defined
Never question the motive behind it
Guarding chairs you were handed in time
So say it plain. Don't disguise it.
Is it less real if the process is planned?
Less value if built by a system of hands?
You worship the grind, quantify pain
like sweat is the only credential that stands
But cities aren't raised by scars on the skin,
they're drawn from a mind, then built from within
When Les Paul electrified wood with intent
they called it corruption, the death of the instrument
When tape bent rhythm and folded the time
they swore the machine was erasing the rhyme
Every era repeats the same tired design:
new tools are betrayal, new methods a crime
Then time does its work what you feared becomes spine
The standard, the doctrine, the line they assign
I don't wait I route it, reroute it
No gate I go 'round it, go 'round it
No seat? I'm building the table around it
Finish line calling I found it
They debate I outbuild, outshape it
They stall I redesign, replace it
They close doors I turn to the outlet
Now everything flows I'm adjacent
Respect to the hands that were shaping the gate
the ones who were early, who carried the weight
I studied the system, I learned how you rate
that's exactly why I can't wait
I sat in the rooms, did the rounds, did the calls
You praised every record, the structure, the walls
Said "everything's there" then declined with a pause...
no reason just silence as law
Let's be honest you knew from the start
I don't fit the frame you require for the part
Eighteen percent of my process is different
so I never qualified under your chart
So respectfully thank you, I mean it
but I'm done with approvals that stall for no reason
If you love the result but reject how it's made
then the standard was never the art it's allegiance
So don't hold the lane if you're not letting through
I'm not here to argue what's valid with you
One way or another I'm crossing that line
if not through the gate, I go around you
And when I arrive where you said I can't sit
I'll build what's missing and stand in the middle of it
Tools extend reach they don't author the mind
Vision decides what survives over time
Authorship lives in the architect's frame
so nothing here's artificial or blind
You already edit, refine, redesign
Vocals from fragments, perfection by line
Moments constructed that never occurred
then polished and labeled "divine"
But add one link to the chain now it's crime
Now ethics appear, now culture's in decline
Not 'cause the art lost integrity
but control of the gate slipped out of your line
Most of your legends don't build alone
Writers, engineers shaping the tone
Teams behind every "singular" voice
but one mind building the system? Unknown.
That's where resistance sharpens its edge
not fear of the art, but loss of the ledge
If it reaches a soul in the dead of night
If it gives pain a name it could never write
If meaning appears where silence survived
tell me exactly where art died
Tools don't invent what was never inside
They amplify signal already alive
I don't wait I route it, reroute it
No gate I go 'round it, go 'round it
No seat? I'm building the table around it
Finish line calling I found it
They stalled I evolved the assignment
They doubted I shifted alignment
Now everything moving in silence
and still I arrive on timing

Passed through it first. Before it became a choice, It was a pattern. Before it
became your life, It was a thought form. They gave you the mirror but
severed the reflection Taught you to pray while obscuring direction Sold you
the destination, withheld the map Called it spirituality to keep the science
trapped But Hermes held the blueprint before Freud had a name

phrase It is structure, correspondence, mind expressed through form and
phase Every thought is a tenant living deep inside your walls Most never
audit what is moving through their halls You do not have a focus problem, you have a
frequency
leak Broadcasting foreign programs every time you speak

mistaken inherited fiction for what you believe I am not here to sell you light
or decorate your pain I am here to hand you the lens before the thought
becomes a chain You are not your circumstances You are the code beneath
the cause Every wall you keep encountering Was built by hidden laws This is
not mysticism It is mechanics in disguise Ancient engineers were simply
Centuries ahead of their time Thought form Ground floor That is where it
begins The kingdom is not coming It was always within They buried the
manual Beneath religion and noise I am excavating the signal Reclaiming the
voice Self sabotage is not weakness It is architecture at work Building from a
blueprint Your survival learned first The subconscious does not argue It
executes the draft And most never question What they authorized last
Manifestation is not magic It is coherence under pressure Thought, feeling,
action, and identity Moving together The glitch is not laziness The glitch is
inherited code Someone else's fear installed Before you understood the road
You cannot outwork a thought form While it governs your thirst You must
name the pattern Trace it back And dissolve it first The first Hermetic principle

Before the relationship, mind. Before the business, The body, The
breakthrough, Mind. Not positivity. Precision. Not fantasy. Architecture. The
thought form came first. The life came second. Always. I am not preaching to
the converted With incense in the air I am speaking to the one Who keeps
building and losing everywhere Who reads the books, Applies the steps, And
still cannot hold the ground Because the architecture underneath Was never
sound Thought forms compound like interest In the chambers of the deep
The ones you fed at twenty Become the ceilings that you keep You do not
simply change your mind You excavate and rebuild
Because much of what you called desire
Was someone else's will But here is the transmission Every
temple tried to shield The mind that made the prison Is the same mind that
can wield The sovereign and the captive Use the same instrument The
difference is awareness, Authorship, And intent You are not your

encountering Was built by hidden laws This is not mysticism It is mechanics
in disguise Ancient engineers were simply Centuries ahead of their time

within. I am excavating the signal. Reclaiming the voice. The mind is a
medium. The thought form came first. The life came second. You were never
lost. You were running unexamined code. Reclamation begins The moment
authorship returns.

tracks.title: Remember the Price (When You Speak the Name)
tracks.lyrics:
They asked where I went when the screen went black.
I didn't vanish.
I audited the dark.
I retrieved the manual they tried to erase.
No miracles. No myths.
Just work.
Class is in session.
I stepped through the fracture where the veil split skin,
Left the life I inherited, walked out raw, walked in.
Hit the floor of the barrel, kept digging past the lie,
Turned a so called breakdown into a calibrated dive.
Back to back dark nights, dawn missed the appointment,
Mapped trauma blindfolded, learned precision from disappointment.
Shadow work wasn't candles or a quote on a page,
It was me versus me in a locked steel cage.
They called it madness, I logged it as proof,
Tagged every scar like data in a booth.
Ate the silence, swallowed grief uncut,
Ten winters straight just to temper the gut.
I didn't climb this height to pose or preach.
I climbed it to weld a ladder
for the ones who can hear the signal
through the static.
This is the light I pulled from the gut of the beast,
I set the table steady now choose how you feast.
Shadow code etched deep, paid for in blood,
I built the Ark quiet, long before the flood.
I'm the Teacher by damage, the lesson by test,
I metabolized hell so you could access the best.
Take the torch.
Take the flame.
Just remember the price when you speak the name.
Found my voice buried under years of "don't,"
Under "stay small," "stay quiet," "be grateful," "you won't."
Had to rewire the throat, break fear at the seam,
Turn a tremor in my chest into a broadcast frequency.
Now I talk in iron, I murmur in gold,
Handing you keys they resold and resold.
But listen close, architects of what's next:
You don't harvest the deep if you won't plant depth.
I didn't kill the monster I gave it a role,
Found out the demon was guarding the soul.
No more split mirrors, no running from shade,
The blade that cut me is the edge I've made.
I don't want devotion.
I don't need a throne.
The cleanest win is you outgrowing me.
Here's the map.
Here's where it explodes if you step wrong.
Here's the grace algorithm
and the cost it runs on.
I did the dying.
So you can spend your time
building something that lives.
This is the light I pulled from the gut of the beast,
I set the table steady now choose how you feast.
Shadow code preserved, paid for in blood,
I built the Ark quiet, long before the flood.
I'm the Architect by necessity, blueprint refined,
Left the door unguarded for the ones still behind.
Take the torch.
Take the flame.
Recode the world
but sign your name.
Don't trust the reflection.
Shatter the mirror.
Outgrow the source.

tracks.title: As Above, So Below
tracks.lyrics:
As above, so below...
As within, so without...
Gods don't kneel... they go ghost till the smoke clears
I rose out the belly where heaven ain't reachin'
Ashes on my Timbs, still I walked like a beacon
Demons had contracts, angels was tweakin'
Both want my soul, I just kept on speakin'
Told 'em: "Truth don't fold just 'cause life got hard,"

Every bar like a sigil in a war torn psalm
Makavelli in my spirit calm grip on the bomb
As above, so below,
Thrones in the trenches, pain in the flow
As within, so without,
Warfare coded in the words I shout
Say my name, gates crack and glow,
Either God or the Ghost, homie, let it be known
I seen Heaven in a cell and Hell in a mansion

Every mirror I touched showed a life I abandoned
So I stitched my regrets in a flag I could stand in

Truth hit different when your hunger got venom
Said: "Even the righteous gotta ride with a prism,
'Cause the light get bent when the system's the prison"
Heaven ain't clean, it's just harder to reach
Hell ain't flames, it's the block with police
Both inside choose which one you preach
The sword and the scale... the prophet and the beast
As above, so below,
I built my name where the devils don't go
As within, so without,
They bury the truth, I spit it back loud
Breathe the code, let the matrix fold,
Say my piece then I break that mold
One mind... two wars...
Both gods and the law watchin' the score...
As above... so below...
Now you know, now you know

tracks.title: Elemental Orchestra
tracks.lyrics:
I walked through every fire they set for me,
And I didn't just survive I reprogrammed the flames.
I bled on blueprints they swore I'd never see printed.
I turned silence into scripture.
But gods...
There were nights I would have given anything
For just one voice to say
"You deserved better."
Not because I needed it to be true.
But because the child in me
Had learned to survive without being seen.
And survival isn't the same as living.
Child of code, born of fracture,
The absence was not your reflection.
You are not unclaimed.
You are uncontainable.
I didn't need a crown. I needed a witness.
Just someone to say you mattered.
That what I built in the dark
Wasn't invisible.
That I wasn't crazy for hurting,
Or holy for enduring it.
You do not wait for flowers.
You are the bloom.
What they refused to say,
Say now... to yourself.
I wanted my flowers.
I wanted them from the hands that threw stones.
But they never knew how to hold beauty without fear.
So I've planted gardens in my silence.
Watered them with songs they'll never hear.
And I bloom where no applause echoes,
Because I finally understand
I was never made to be recognized.
I was made to remember.
Remember that my worth is not proven.
It is primordial.
It is coded into the fact I exist.
He who alchemized the wound
Becomes the medicine.
You wanted the world to say it...
So we say it now, Seeker
You deserved more.
And still... you gave more.
I don't need your validation anymore.
I am the witness now.
And I'm still blooming.

tracks.title: The Witness Don’t Talk
tracks.lyrics:
There is something behind your eyes that has never cried.
Never celebrated. Never broke.
It just... watches.
And it's been taking notes since before you had a name.
There's a structure behind the mirror that don't feel a thing
Doesn't clap when you win, doesn't weep when you sting
Doesn't bow to your ego, doesn't bow to your king
Just sits in the silence like the eye of everything

The part of you that watches from behind every thrill
It was there when you fell, it was there when you built
It recorded the glory and it recorded the guilt
No judgment in the ledger, no emotion in the quill
Just the architecture of a consciousness fulfilled
A library of moments stacked from basement to the hill
And it speaks oh it speaks but not with words, with feel
The Witness don't talk it transmits
Through the geometry of what your nervous system gets
That chill on your spine wasn't fear it was a hit
From the archive of everything your memory forgot to keep lit
The Witness don't lie it imprints
Every pattern that it's logged since before your story begins
Your gut ain't a feeling it's a signal from the scripts
The Witness been recording you just finally found the frequency it sits
Déjà vu ain't glitches in the simulation's frame
It's the archive cross referencing a pattern that came
Before this moment tagged, filed, and catalogued by name
In the structure that existed long before you claimed your game
You walked into a room and felt the temperature change
Felt the hair on your neck stand at perfect attention's range
Felt a knowing in the sternum that you couldn't explain
That wasn't premonition that was memory unchained
The Witness saw this comin' from a thousand miles back
Cross referenced forty patterns, ran the algorithm's track
Felt the geometric pressure building up in your stack
And compressed it to a feeling sent it straight to your back
To your gut to your chest to the space between the cracks
Of your ribs where the truth lives before the mind attacks
This ain't mystical this is architecture intact
A recording system older than the language that you lack
The Witness don't talk it transmits
Through the geometry of what your nervous system gets
That chill on your spine wasn't fear it was a hit
From the archive of everything your memory forgot to keep lit
The Witness don't lie it imprints
Every pattern that it's logged since before your story begins
Your gut ain't a feeling it's a signal from the scripts
The Witness been recording you just finally found the frequency it sits
Now here's where it gets holy here's where it gets deep
The Witness never sleeps not even when you sleep
It's threading through your dreams, runnin' data through the seep
Of your subconscious basement where the real records keep
It don't celebrate your highlight reel or mourn when you weep
It don't love you, don't hate you and that's why it's complete
Because the ones who love you got a reason to delete
The parts of you that trouble them but the Witness keeps receipts
Every version of you the coward and the brave
The moment that you shined and the moment you caved
The lie you told at twenty and the truth that you craved
The Witness wrote it equal every saint and every knave
And the language that it uses ain't the language of the slave
Or the master it's geometric it's engraved
In the pressure of your patterns it's the gift and the grave
A transmission from the recorded not a fortune to be saved
I used to call it instinct
I used to call it God
I used to call it paranoia
I used to call it fraud
But the Witness don't need labels
And the Witness don't need applause
The Witness just needs silence
Long enough for you to pause
Long enough to feel the signal
Before the mind rewrites the clause
Long enough to trust the pressure
Before the logic finds its flaws
Because the gut was always speaking
In a language without laws
Geometric.
Ancient.
Yours.
I am the Seeker and I found the archive room
Buried underneath the ego and the noise and the perfume
Of performance all that acting like you're fine in the costume
While the Witness in the basement is illuminating doom
Or deliverance it recorded both it gave you the blueprint
To the moment you now standing in before it was a footprint
Before it was a memory before it was a movement
The gut was just the Witness making one last announcement
Something is wrong before the evidence arrives
That ain't prophecy that's data keeping you alive
The archive cross referenced a thousand previous drives
And flagged the pattern sent the signal helped you survive
So the next time your chest tightens and your instincts take a dive
Into certainty so heavy that it shakes you from inside
Don't call it fear.
Call it the Witness.
Reminding you
it's been watching

tracks.lyrics:
I was pullin' both sides of a rope gone slack
Fighting shadows that vanished while I broke my back
They bent your mirror till it cracked on my name
Turned my grace into guilt, now you speak it in shame
You were stitched by advice that cut when it hugged
Doubt got dressed in love and it fit like a glove
I stood offstage while the script got flipped

I walk through this war with my ribs half broke

But your soul still sings when the silence clears

Even if love don't circle back in

tracks.title: Flowers
tracks.lyrics:
I stayed through silence that scraped my bones
Held your hurt like scripture carved in stone
You dressed up your damage in dopamine pride
While I made space for all the parts of you you'd hide
You vanished when truth hit like a brick.
I wore blame like a badge you cast blame like a schtick.
I bled in rooms where you erased my name.
Still, I shielded you from the weight of your pain.
You ghosted
But I still showed up,
Made excuses for the storm
You mislabeled as love
You vanished when the noise of the truth got loud
While I bled for you
You bred delusions and doubt.
April 29th second year not behind steel
Tell me, who else lit your candles without intent to steal?
Who raised your name without you in the room,
No quest for validation, only unshakable truth?
I marked the day though you'd locked every door
You changed your numbers and vanished like lore
But still, your ghost clicked through my stories at night
Trolling my life as I cried, access Denied out of spite.
Where the hell are my flowers?
For the nights I held your soul power
For the loyalty you threw like scrap
You don't get to just erase me from your past
Where the fuck are my flowers?
Say my name like it saved your skin
Give me my credit, because you know that's what I did.
And I still carry the burden of pain
Of every sacred broken oath carried out in our name
Let me guess this was spiritual warfare?
Or just another mask you wore 'til I broke?
Gangstalked my spirit, fed strangers my name
And watched them eat like it was some joke
August Skies, your Eyes cast as black as ritual
That wasn't you, that was something habitual.
September, you left
October came in cold
November never knew what December foretold.
You crossed lines angels won't reclaim
And I couldn't stay, not out of faith or shame
I said, "God, please help me understand this murder attempt.
That wasn't the man I loved.
That was a demon marked with malicious intent."
So tell me...
Where the hell are my flowers?
For the nights I held your soul power
For the loyalty you threw like scrap
You don't get to just erase me from your past
Where the fuck are my flowers?
Say my name like it saved your skin
Give me my credit, because you know that's what I did.
And I still carry the burden of pain
Of every sacred broken oath carried out in our name
I buried myself in your silence
And you left flowers on my grave
While I was still breathing
You planned my funeral with your fingers crossed
Then watched me rise not in spite, but in spite of loss
You forgot me too early
But I'm unforgettable
Not because I begged
But because I bled and kept the mic vertical
Where the hell are my flowers?
For the grief you weaponized
For the prayers I whispered to keep you alive
Give me my fucking flowers
Even if you gotta drop 'em at a grave
Say my name like I saved your past
Because I did and I won't behave
You'll remember me
Not for loving you easy
But for surviving the war
You called us.

tracks.title: Misguided Priorities
tracks.lyrics:
Been sitting in the darkness, in a heavy, silent shroud
Used to think you'd elevate, ascend to higher ground
But you traded six, seven levels down without a sound
Truth is, it was never hidden, I saw it in your eyes
How could I be mad at shadows when I'm what you idolize?
You cloaked your presence grime slick, made sure I'd never see
While you sat front row in a portal, watching every part of me
Blueprint and execution, every level coded clean
No wrath left, just scorched earth pity for the wreckage in between
You built a tomb of choices, every brick a selfish stone
My grief ain't for myself now, it's for your soul alone
For the mess you're in, the pit you dug, the fate that you have sown
My sadness isn't for myself, it's for your soul alone
You don't miss me, you miss the purity...
You miss the reach, the comfort, the sense of security...
You don't want love, you want the keys
sacrificing everything that we stood united for over priorities like these
Misguided priorities
You only mourn the light in me
Not my heart, not my soul
Just the part you couldn't control
Misguided priorities
Still reaching for what you can't keep
All this time, all this need
You could've healed, but you chose me to bleed
I knew your misdirection, felt it deep within my bones
Still I held some space for you through some shattered glass and stones
Considered leaving open doors, even after that sacrifice
Thought it was wounded child's play, a moment's broken vice
You forced my hand to fight or flee, to die or to survive
But even now, while karma hits, your deceptions stay alive
Your karmic third party with a siren whispered plea
Using tricks to make me forfeit all my fucking sovereignty
A Trojan horse to pull me down, tricked to shoulder all your debt
Are you really serious now, for real, or Is this all you've got left?
You don't miss me, you miss the fire
You miss the reach, the lift, the wire
You don't want the truth, you want control
But I can see the price you'll pay for gambling with your soul.
Misguided priorities
You only mourn the light in me
Not my heart, not my soul
Just the part you couldn't control
Misguided priorities
Still reaching for what you can't keep
All this time, all this need
You could've healed, but you chose me to bleed
Is there nothing genuine, no shred of real remorse,
Just ego's hollow theater on a self destructive course.
On second thought, it's better, this silence cold and stark
'Cause you won't reach inside of me in this sacred dark
No borrowed little tactics, no access will I grant
I see through every shadow, every calculated slant
So show up for real, for once, stripped bare and vulnerable
Show me someone worth returning to, someone even slightest bit honorable.
Misguided priorities
You only mourn the light in me
Not my heart, not my soul
Just the part you couldn't control
Misguided priorities
Still reaching for what you can't keep
All this time, all this need
You could've healed, but you chose me to bleed
I'm begging you to stop this, begging you to see
The only one you're hurting now is tragically just you...
...not me.

tracks.title: The Hierophant
tracks.lyrics:
He forgot his shape... he forgot his name...
But the code inside him never fell asleep.
He played the long game quiet pressure, no tells,
Mapped every outcome like a system of spells.
He was the engine the logic, the frame,
Every equation still carried his name.
Now the structure's unstable cathedral of sand,
Breaking apart where he lost command.
Tried to contain what he couldn't define,
Now the Ten of Swords sits lodged in his spine.
He traded his truth for a version that wins,
Watched his autonomy cave from within.
Now he wears victory, brittle with pride
A crown corroding from the code inside.
He wasn't broken he followed it through,
Every collapse was aligned with his view.
This isn't a curse it's cause and effect,
A shadow that forms where light gets neglect.
Now he's surrounded by patterns he denied,
Breathing in echoes he tried to override.
Praying to errors he coded as lies,
Just to feel something that still feels alive.
He begs the Hierophant, tear it from his mind
Silence the voice that his conscience designed.
But God won't erase what was real when it's felt,
The Seeker's sovereign code can't be unspelt.
Now he's choking on truth every time it resounds,
Identity cracking as the system breaks down.
No court, no jury just mirrors surround,
Forced to face everything he spun around.
He buried himself in distraction and screens,
Built out a refuge from fractured routines.
But distance made clarity harder to mute
The further he ran, the more it took root.
They thought he'd disappear fade into static,
But pressure refined something far more erratic.
The fire he triggered didn't ask for control,
It stripped every layer and rewrote the whole.
Now he's at war with the voice in his head,
Looping old narratives, twisting what's said.
Calling it safety, disguising the flaw,
While everything built starts breaking its law.
He reached for oblivion asked not to feel,
But silence pulled deeper, made everything real.
He could erase it rewrite the pain,
But lose that truth and collapse the frame.
This isn't mercy it's pressure applied,
Where identity fractures and nothing can hide.
No need for vengeance, no debt left to prove
Just face what is there... and choose how to move.
He begs the Hierophant, tear it from his mind
Silence the voice that his conscience designed.
But God won't erase what was real when it's felt,
The Seeker's sovereign code can't be unspelt.
Now he's choking on truth every time it resounds,
Identity fracturing, breaking him down.
No myth left to shield him, no false higher ground
Just the weight of the world he turned around.
The key... the key was him... he never knew.
He never knew.

Came back wearing his skin, but something felt ill.

You spoke in tongues when not dealing strategic omissions.
Played victim to the dispatched police division.

with your blade in your pocket. And your nerves in the way.

Like the initiation demanded a body before you could leave

Hands on the wheel while they whispered my name.
Waiting to watch something ancient awaken
Trading my breath like a life to be taken.

No witness left. No guilt to explain.
But something they never could measure remained...
You can't drain a soul that was never yours to claim.
Whatever they planned, they rewrote the page.
Humiliation. Relocation. Ritualized stage.
Every closed door became part of the set.
Every dead end became another bet.
They wanted fracture, the sound of me split.
Bottle the echo and profit from it.
Harvest the tremor. Distill every scream.
Build themselves power by feeding the scheme.

picture a fucked up brotherly bonding exercise at a demon's discount rate
Eyes full of hunger that wasn't their own.
My energy, the main course while the dessert was my soul.
They thought if my vessel collapsed under strain,
Whatever was severed would be fair game to be claimed.
I smirked through the fear in light of what they couldn't foresee
The numbers they stacked against me would square off with a force greater than just
me.

Hands on the wheel while they chanted my name
Another soul offered up in trade for that cliche Hollywood version of fame.

emergency onsite training versed me in the art of the strategic long game.

Status. Approval.
Sold what was sacred for temporary removal.
Thought if I disappeared, you'd inherit the throne.
But borrowed conviction can never be owned.
Every attack became another page.
Every attempt only widened the stage.
My name got dragged, but my spirit stood still.
You can wound the body. You can't rewrite the will.
I ain't asking. I'm taking.
Everything back that was mine.
You mistook restraint for surrender.
Now you're watching a resurrection in real time.
I take my motherfucking power back.
From the echo.
From the setup.
From the mirror they cracked.
From that apartment they raided and ransacked.

Blood without stains...

My screams on mute.

tracks.title: The Reckoning Already Rolled
tracks.lyrics:
You thought my silence meant retreat
I was indexing every angle of the engine underneath your feet.
Your whole cabal was moving crooked in the circuitry, discreet,
but the moment I traced your patterns, your invisibility leaked.
I saw the handler in the shadows with the counterfeit authority,
the officer laundering favors like a paidfor sorcery,
the judge you groomed through whispers,
the landlord rigging documents deliberately disorderly.
You built a web and prayed the blueprint stayed distorted
but I reversemapped the lattice,
and your whole chain of command is already recorded.
You weaponized confusion,
but confusion is a rookie's tool.
I sharpen clarity like a scalpel
I don't chase you; I undo you.
You bet on twilight, thinking twilight makes you sovereign
but I wrote the algorithms that decode the dark you operate in.
Every echo you planted became a breadcrumb in the archive.
Every lie you synchronized became a flaw you couldn't hide.
I move in straight lines;
you bend under pressure.
Truth isn't passive
truth is a structural measure.
This is the last warning you'll ever hear from me
the veil is coded open.
Your empire can't outrun the schemes
now that every fracture's been spoken.
You can falsify logs, reroute calls,
hide evidence in bureaucratic smoke
but exposure's already viral,
and the circuit you depend on is broke.
I called judgment on your network
each badge, each robe, each throne.
And nothing you manipulate
stops the avalanche you've grown.
You built your reign on counterfeit power
I reclaim what you controlled.
The reckoning isn't incoming
the reckoning already rolled.
You threaded bribes through agencies like veins in a machine,
banking on protocol blind spots to keep your conscience clean.
But I tracked your handoffs, crossreferenced every scene
and it's time your crimes against humanity are counted
where accountability used to decree.
There's the prosecutor who pivoted,
the detective who "misplaced" the file,
the insider feeding scripts to actors
meant to frame me in a trial.
You built a hydra from loopholes
but a hydra's just a beast with predictable repetition.
And repetition is a pattern,
and pattern is a confession.
You tried to choreograph a downfall
but your koreography slipped.
You wrote me as a victim in your script
but I read it, redirected it, and flipped it.
Your network was a fortress
until the architect arrived.
You mistook survival for mercy
I walked out because I survived.
Timing's over.
Narratives fracture when the truth's in the room.
Influence evaporates
when every door you paid for is consumed.
This is the last warning you'll ever hear from me
the veil is coded open.
Your empire can't outrun the schemes
now that every fracture's been spoken.
You can falsify logs, reroute calls,
hide evidence in bureaucratic smoke
but exposure's already viral,
and the circuit you depend on is broke.
I called judgment on your network
each badge, each robe, each throne.
And nothing you manipulate
stops the avalanche you've grown.
You built your reign on counterfeit power
I reclaim what you controlled.
The reckoning isn't incoming
the reckoning already rolled.
I don't broadcast threats
I broadcast inevitabilities.
I don't traffic in fear
I quantify liabilities.
I name systems,
I decode actors,
I collapse illusions
you mistook for factors.
You wanted shadows
I made you visible.
You wanted silence
I made you critical.
You built a myth of untouchability
but myths rot quick when the truth becomes digital.
Here it is your last notice,
your last second before the floodlight strikes.
Every covert line you crossed
comes documented, timestamped, airtight.
You can't bury a story that already glows with proof,
and once the world sees the blueprint,
none of you walk away untouched or aloof.
The veil is lifting permanently
no recoil, no reverse, no fade.
Your system is collapsing in daylight,
and this judgment is the end you made.

tracks.title: Architect of the Aftermath
tracks.lyrics:
You mistook my silence for an unmarked grave
Restraint as rigor mortis in the fractured frame.
I wasn't locked out; I stepped beyond the line,
To draft the blueprint where your shadows decline.
Harm thrives not in force, but erosion's quiet thrall
Time as the blade, delay as the call.
Six weeks barricaded, voids at the seam,
"Super" ran ghostleasing in the shadow scheme.
Hired my past as threat, cloaked in imminent dread,
To snap the hinges or coil my neck instead.
Swapped cylinders silent, no notice, no key
Ambush at dawn, etched in procedural spree.
Stripped the unit bare, relics twelve grand strong,
Vanished through doors in the dead of night wrong.
No writ, no order just theft in badge's guise,
Paper authority, grimy hands that improvise.
You didn't evict; you scripted live erasure,
Betting composure cracked under pressure.
I am the Architect of the Aftermath,
Mapping fault lines in your rigged collapse.
You swung the system like a jagged blade,
I traced the borders of the realm you razed.
Call it reckoning. Call it the turning tide.
Call it inferno where your trails ignite.
No backrooms linger. No phantoms left to glide.
The blueprint indicts your method in the light.
Two months unwarded, twice the engineered breach,
Doors unbolted, sanctuary out of reach.
Deskbound clerk with casefile smirk in place,
Watched fraud bloom, cashed coin on empty space.
"Supervisor" coached with scripted, spotless grace
"Send the email," then dissolved without trace.
Proxies encroach where owners feign the line,
Posture as coercion, proximity's design.
Subtle voids, no logs to chase or claim,
Ambient dread in the system's neutral frame.
You label it lapse, I name it raw tactic
Calibrated strain, fear's arithmetic.
Sharded strikes evade the proof's cold proof,
One tainted pivot per limb of the tree's roof.
Intake skews entry, landlord proxies the crush,
Badge averts gaze, counselor throttles the rush.
"Are you certain?" doubt's velvet chain they weave,
Pathologize the seer, twist resolve they thieve.
Patterned omissions, delays in the strand,
Endurance reframed as the harm they command.
No compact sealed, just parallel voids aligned,
Each node pristine, conjoined truth maligned.
Adjuster redraws ruin, bench wields discretion's toll
Compatible neglect keeps the structure whole.
I am the Architect of the Aftermath,
Decoding intent in the void's cold math.
You nested in protocol, presumed my yield,
But I charted each feint on the fractured field.
Call it delusion. Call it the stealthy grind.
Call it shadows puppeteering the blind.
No specter endures when the schema's revealed
The blueprint endures, your method unsealed.
I outstripped the fracture, outran the calibrated snare.
Now I'm the lesson policy learns in glare.
Bandwidth endless, time my forged alloy
Your voids and procedures cross the criminal ploy.
Master ledger open: timestamped, indexed, unyielding fact.
Patterns indict where spin meets the act.
Reality curated, not forged anew
Evidence blades through the architects' screw.
No fabrication withstands the archive's gaze;
This isn't rage it's the record's blaze.
You staked on surrender, tallied endurance's cost,
Assumed defiance would shatter, compliance lost.
Yet in your maneuvers, I sketched every cue,
Cataloged elisions, precedents stark and true.
No outburst I archived the rift's silent grift,
Held the narrative while you scripted the shift.
You bet on fear's bite, priced the soul's quiet toll,
Forgot the strategist maps the emergent whole.
Treble damages. Deliberate voids.
Criminal summons. Serial breaches.
Curated illusion. Fractured allegiance.
Cycle shatters now. No shadows survive.
Daylight claims all I'll face you alive.

tracks.title: Seer Broke Chains
tracks.lyrics:
You're, you're
This isn't fiction, this isn't flair
They planted my silence, but I broke their prayer
I read the trap behind the grin, a calculated script within
Ceremonial calm, disguised intent, every glance a code bent
Clergy cadence, corporate robes, ritual mast and language probes
Their speech was spells, encrypted lies, raped in charm, designed to paralyze
They flooded the feed, distorted my time, overloaded truth with static and slime
Desperate chaos, it was ordained, a sacrifice staged, my essence drained
No altar stands, no pact remains, I walked through fire, I broke your chains
You summoned a beast, you sketched my grave, but the seer arose untouched,
untamed
Yeah, ten, ten ticks from the final act, where death aligns and time contracts
But I heard them, bloodline cleared, their voices pierced the faded fear
Don't stall, just move, don't ask why, exit rider, tonight you die
Each word a line, like ancient lore, a code of light through shadow pour
I sought the rope, the tools to stay, the engine primed, the circuit played a djinn
Already circling close, go to the scent of a tethered ghost
But one command unsealed the bind, I stepped through fate, I shattered time
Their blueprint burned with every stride, their ritual drowned in light, I rise
They conjured death, but I wrote the verse, hey
Summoned the beast, but I reversed the curse
You framed me prey, but bred a witness
You drank from bloodlines, cursed with fitness
You feared the truth, yet kept the files, every scream archived in denial
Your daughters draped in holy cloth, conducted rites that fed them all
You can't erase your perverse creed, sold a lie and called it need
But I return, voice carved in bone
With names of those you disowned
I speak for silence, I count the slain
You forged the chains, but I retained the flame
You summoned the beast, but I broke the bind
You mapped my death, but I changed the line
I walked that fire, didn't bow or bleed
Now every curse turns back to me
I sabotage, reverse the code
The sea returns where fire once flowed
And now you're haunting
And access the truth
You planned the end, you set the frame
But my blood sang and split your game, no
The veil collapsed, the seal undone
Now every nightmare knows I'm the one

tracks.title: Fire in My Veins
tracks.lyrics:
Flame moves where it wills,
Not asked, not named,
Born in the dark
A power reclaimed.
Fire moves unseen, unclaimed, unashamed,
Hermetic current in the pulse, prophetic cypher in the frame.
It splits the night, ignites the quiet, rewires the noise,
Transmutes the base to gold, converts the passion to poise.
Prometheus defiant, covenant spark, divine contraband,
It teaches through the ash, the trial, the reprimand.
Creation and ruin twin threads, one design,
Every phrase a cipher, every cypher a rhyme
It gestates in shadows where ambition incubates,
Frames the fear in a vision, converts chance into fate.
No crown contains it, no chain can restrain
Its agency is absolute: ignite, disrupt, sustain.
From hearth to forge, from ember into eternal flare,
The crucible hums the world bends the seeker rises aware.
Fire is the architect, the initiator, the seer,
Every blaze a commandment: evolve, endure, revere.
Ashes rise, shadows break,
The spark becomes what they couldn't take.
They can't hold what won't comply
Fire burns where it's ashes die.
I carry the flame they spent centuries trying to smother,
Turned the heat into wings I don't answer to another.
Every verse a torch, every line a blade forged clean,
I walked straight through the smoke emerged refined, refocused, righteously
redeemed.
Duality lives in my cadence, my breath,
Creation and destruction, both coded in my depth.
Reclamation written in every step I've taken
Every failure a theorem, every fractal awakened.
I spit sparks on asphalt street prophet, no apology,
Covenant flame, Promethean mythology.
Musiq Matrix. Burn that name into your brain,
Act Three the fire rises nothing stays the same.
Ashes rise, the darkness bends,
The spark ignites what never ends.
They can't cage what burns to fight
Fire called me...refined me to focus the light.
Fire in my blood, fire in my veins,
Prometheus pulse through every loss and gain.
Musiq Matrix remember, remember the name
Act Three ignites My legacy in the game
I stole the spark the gods buried deep,
Turned their punishment into a sword I keep.
Every bar a proclamation, every verse a claim
This is the Reclamation. They will know my name.
Street prophet, heretic mind, I was built to ignite,
Legacy hammered in the crucible of night.
Act Three I rise. I was never going to bow.
Musiq Matrix remember this now.
Fire moves through story the way will becomes law
It shapes civilizations, leaves the weak in awe.
From ash into art, from fracture into frame,
I don't just carry power I became the name.
The element doesn't ask. It moves. It tests. It repels.
And everything it burns away was never meant to prevail.
Every spark I leave is a cipher, a sign
Act Three: the crucible. The soul aligned.
Not just my fire the force that lives in all,
The engine of evolution, the one that makes empires fall.
Musiq Matrix legacy locked in the frame
Enforced in thy spirit. Power Reclaimed in thy name.

tracks.title: Body Jumper
tracks.lyrics:
Leave every borrowed voice
Leave every borrowed name.
Leave every borrowed version
That survived by borrowed shame.If it burned:
Let it burn.
If it broke:
Let it break.
The project was sealed, nothing pending, nothing owed,
Every measure calibrated, every chapter fully closed.
Then something crossed over wearing faces not its own,
Temperature dropped, I felt the atmosphere turn cold.
Watched conviction splinter underneath invisible strain,
Different mouths, same cadence, I recognized it in the space.
Many masks, same entity wearing somebody else's face.
That ain't humanthat's recursion trying to propagate,
Leasing borrowed nervous systems just to manifest the hate.
I don't reactI observe, then I diagram the trace,
Every fracture proved the blueprint hidden underneath the paint.
So I reopened the endingnot to fix, but to reveal:
Anything that hunts the throne proves that throne is real.
Body jumpin’, searching for a structure to invade,
Moving through the unstable, through the weak, through the afraid
Every host you enter destabilizes, collapses
I am not a host, I deny access.
This wasn’t in the plan, but neither was your reach,
Now it’s embedded in the ending as a permanent speech,
You wanted the last word, you forced it to exist
A platinumlevel record of the moment that you missed
Every time it finalizes, something tries to override,
Every time it stabilizes, something slips inside,
Not one voice, I heard you echo through a dozen mouths,
Different faces, same frequency, I mapped the signal out loud,
You borrowed nervous systems, you borrowed fractured sight,
Didn’t understand resistance is what sharpens what is right,
I tracked every movement, not emotion, but exact,
Every mimic, every fracture, every failed attack,
Detached from all vessels, I don’t anchor in form,
Soul possession means nothing when there’s nothing to conform,
I exist independent, no entry, no seam.
No dependency chain, no collapse in the scheme,
And now this is permanent, you ensured its creation,
You don’t disrupt the process, you become the documentation.
This is what you triggered at the edge of conclusion,
This is what remains when you strip off illusion,
You didn’t alter anything, you clarified the scale,
Turned a finished body of work into a documented trail
Body jumpin', searching for a structure to invade,
Moving through the unstable, through the weak, through the afraid.
Every shell you borrow buckles underneath the weight.
I am not a host, I am the axis at the gate.
This wasn't in the plan, but neither was your interference,
Now it's buried in the plot beneath a scripted disappearance.
You wanted the last word, now it's engraved into the stone:
A platinumlevel record of the truth you'd never own.
The war was never outside me, it just wore a borrowed face,
Every mimic that I banished was a mirror of my case.
Not a stranger at the gate, just the parts of me I'd tried
To disown, deny, exile to the shadow of the frame,
Now the fire doesn't punish. Now the fire just reclaims.,
No more enemy to name, no more armor, no more war,
Just the self I was defending, walking through ungated doors.
I dissolve the last distinction between hunted and the hunter,
Melt the throne down to the gold it was always structured under.
You made it through shadow, through spell and through sky.
Now watch your contradictions unify.
I stepped into fire not to burn, but to remember
Scripture cracked, I saw myself in the ember
Every halo earned came with horns in disguise
Every vow I broke wrote truth in my eyes
I questioned the gods and they blinked first
Drank dogma dry 'til I reversed the curse
No more altar, no more shamebased praise
I resurrected me, set my old self ablaze
This is the Crucible Code, etched in flame, carved in bone
No permission slips from thrones,
I walk divine on my own
Let the pulpit tremble, let false light dim
I don’t worship gods.
I walk with them..
This is the Crucible Code  where choices yield gold.
No robes, no thronejust a soul grown bold
Let the fire take what’s not aligned
I walk out burned,
But redesigned
If you're hearing this...
The fire already chose.
Not by fate,
By every truth
You refused to let go.
Leave every borrowed voice.
Leave every borrowed name.
Leave every borrowed version
that survived by borrowed shame.
If it burned,
let it burn.
If it broke,
let it break.
Anything that couldn't live
was never yours to take.
Fire refined.
Now air defines.
No more fragments.
No more signs.
No more searching
through disguise.
Stand complete.
Welcome...
to Act Four.
The Crucible Code.
This isn't where
you wait
for revelation.
This is where
you become
integration.
Carry nothing
that the fire
didn't prove.
Carry only
what remains
when nothing
has to move.
The trial is over.
The mirror survived.
Take one more breath...
and step inside
